author: Kaos_Shadow
body:
So this is my updated version of a map I made ages ago, and was never reviewed :/ :P
It was on the old forums, so I cant find it anymore, if i do, i will edit in a link if i find it xD

It's called Juavez (Who-ah-vays) and is a Control the hill map.

Download (plz have a look around!): http://www.mediafire.com/download/kxe2dpt4fu7abrq/%C2%A7aJuavez.zip

Imgur Album: http://imgur.com/a/aNiON 

Thx for all the support on the earlier version!
For anyone wondering, it didnt get reviewed because of the forum change in Avicore and I couldnt find the old thread:P
